# Styling guidelines

The library renders inside partner apps, so its styles must not collide with theirs. `tailwind.config.js` sets `prefix: 'eb-'` and scopes Tailwind's preflight to `.eb-component` containers. Every Tailwind utility in `embedded-components` needs the prefix. An unprefixed class isn't generated by the library build, so it does nothing, or picks up whatever the host app defines.

## Prefix syntax (Tailwind 3)

| Case | Write | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Utility | `eb-flex eb-gap-4` | `flex gap-4` |
| Variant | `md:eb-text-base`, `hover:eb-bg-primary-hover`, `data-[state=open]:eb-rotate-180` | `eb-md:text-base` |
| Negative value | `-eb-mt-2` | `eb--mt-2` |
| Important | `!eb-p-0` | `eb-!p-0` |
| Arbitrary value | `eb-w-[320px]` | `w-[320px]` |

## Colors and tokens

Use the semantic colors from the theme, which partners override through `EBComponentsProvider` `theme.variables` (CSS variables named `--eb-*`):

- Surfaces and text: `eb-bg-background`, `eb-text-foreground`, `eb-bg-card`, `eb-bg-muted`, `eb-text-muted-foreground`, `eb-border`, `eb-ring`.
- Actions: `eb-bg-primary eb-text-primary-foreground hover:eb-bg-primary-hover`, plus `secondary` and `destructive` variants.
- Status: `informative`, `warning`, `success` (each has an `-accent` shade).

Avoid raw palette colors (`eb-bg-blue-500`) and hex values in components; they ignore partner theming. Token names and how they map to theme variables are in [`embedded-components/DESIGN_TOKENS.md`](../../../embedded-components/DESIGN_TOKENS.md).

## Building UI

- Combine classes with `cn()` from `@/lib/utils`. Its tailwind-merge setup knows the `eb-` prefix, so a later `className` prop correctly overrides earlier classes.
- Reuse primitives in `src/components/ui/` (shadcn/Radix) before writing new ones. `PopoverContent` and `DialogContent` already render in a portal.
- Loading: `Skeleton` from `@/components/ui/skeleton`, not "Loading..." text.
- API errors: `ServerErrorAlert` from `@/components/ServerErrorAlert`.

## Check it

`npm run lint` skips Tailwind rules for speed. After changing class names, run `npm run lint:styles` from `embedded-components/`; it flags unknown or unprefixed classes (`tailwindcss/no-custom-classname`) and class-order issues.
